meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把想法或现成网页做成能点击跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在会议或路演上展示一份能交互跳转、自带备注的演示稿。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable, branching slide deck with speaker notes from an idea or page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an interactive deck that branches and shows speaker notes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把内容编写成一份可运行、可导航的演示文稿（路演 deck）：每张幻灯片是独立场景，支持分步显示、热点跳转分支、演讲者模式和可编辑备注。产出是可导航的 deck，不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做 slideshow 或演示文稿时接手；若你只是说 “presentation”、“pitch deck” 等相邻说法，或要求把现有网页转成 deck，它会先问一句确认再动手。

say.text: 把这份简报做成一份带演讲者备注的幻灯片 deck
say.note: 它会先确认再开始编写

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片，保留原来的设计和动效
say.note: 按源页面视觉与交互转换

say.text: 在市场那页加个热点，点了跳到方法说明分支
say.note: 热点指向一个分支序列

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude authors a runnable, navigable deck: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, presenter mode with editable notes. Output is a live deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, or ask to convert an existing page into a deck. Adjacent wording like “presentation” or “pitch deck” prompts a confirmation first.

say_en.text: Turn this brief into a slideshow with speaker notes.
Convert this page into a deck, keeping its design and motion.
Add a hotspot on the market slide linking to the methodology branch.
say_en.note: The hotspot points to a branch sequence.
